mechanism: Methimazole can cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, which may be exacerbated by verapamil's potential effects on cellular function; additionally, hyperthyroidism (which methimazole treats) can increase verapamil metabolism and reduce its efficacy.
action: Monitor CBC regularly in patients receiving both drugs; consider alternative antithyroid therapy or calcium channel blocker if agranulocytosis develops; assess verapamil efficacy as thyroid function normalizes with methimazole treatment.
